content:
DevOps Bot: ALERT: 5 failed outbound pages in last 2m — notify-orch returned 503/401 for webhook fanout. Auto-suppress window engaged.

Maria S.: I didn't get a phone page. only slack notif in #incidents.

Aj T.: Same — slack mention arrived but no ring. did incidentbot try a fallback?

Incident Assistant: Automated summary — fanout failures to sms-relay (twilio) and phone-proxy; 401s on signing validation after key rotation job 'rotator-v2' at 03:12 UTC. Suppression rule active: quiet-window >= 3 failures -> auto-squelch.

Oncall SRE (Sam): Confirming — I see incoming webhook errors from notify-orch: 

```
2026-02-18T03:14:09Z notify-orch outgoing webhook to sms-relay returned 401 {"error":"invalid_signature","svc":"sms-relay"}
2026-02-18T03:14:10Z notify-orch outgoing webhook to phone-proxy returned 503 {"error":"upstream_unavailable"}
2026-02-18T03:14:11Z notify-orch suppression triggered for route:critical-pager (policy:fail-window=3m)
```

Aj T.: oh — rotator-v2 ran yesterday during deploy. did the secret sync to notify-orch fail?

DevOps Bot: rotator-v2 deployment log: `POST /secrets/sync -> 202 accepted` then `worker/secret-sync timed out` for notify-orch cluster-3.

Maria S.: I can manually page while we triage. Carmen — can you verify customer impact? any open customer tickets complaining about missed pages?

Support Lead (Carmen): Not seeing inbound support tickets yet. Monitoring shows 2 customer incidents opened in the app (rate-limited alerts) but no 1:1 escalations. I'll call the 2 affected accounts as a precaution.

Oncall SRE (Sam): Mitigation plan: 1) disable auto-suppress for critical routes temporarily 2) re-sync signing key to notify-orch 3) trigger manual fallback pages via ops-runbook script 4) monitor for duplicates. Doing step 1 now.

Aj T.: To disable suppression (runbook):
```bash
# disable for critical-pager
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/suppressions/critical-pager/disable \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${OPS_TOKEN}"
```

Oncall SRE (Sam): suppression disabled (took ~12s). Re-syncing secrets -> running `./scripts/secret-sync notify-orch cluster-3 --force`

DevOps Bot: secret-sync finished: notify-orch cluster-3 -> 200 OK, new signing_key applied.

Incident Assistant: Retrying pending fanout (3 attempts queued). First retry to sms-relay -> 200 OK. phone-proxy still returning intermittent 503, fallback to sms succeeded.

Maria S.: I just got a manual page (voice+sms). confirmed ring.

Support Lead (Carmen): called both accounts — they received page and are aware. no customer outage declared yet.

Aj T.: root cause hypothesis: rotator-v2 had a transient timeout so notify-orch continued to use the old signature but the upstream rejected pre-rotated requests (signature mismatch) -> generated 401s and triggered the suppression policy.

Oncall SRE (Sam): Agreed. Immediate followups: 
- roll back rotator-v2 to stable if we see repeat failures 
- add retries + health-check gating in rotator to ensure notify-orch sync completes before key flip 
- tweak suppression rule to require 5 failures or 30s window for critical-pager (current is 3m/3fail)

Maria S.: Also add a smoke-test that sends a test page after key rotation, and alert if delivery doesn't return 200 in 10s.

Support Lead (Carmen): I'll open a customer comms draft if we need to escalate. so far only precautionary outreach.

Aj T.: Creating incident ticket and assigning to eng-infra for postmortem. I'll include logs and the rotator deployment details.

Incident Assistant: Action items created: INC-2026-0421 (triage), PM-ops: secret-sync retries, ENG-INFRA: rotator rollout safety checklist.

Oncall SRE (Sam): Closing timeline (for now): suppression disabled @03:16, secret sync success @03:18, first successful fallback page @03:18:12. Monitoring continuing for 30m.

Maria S.: Thanks team. We'll draft followup and timeline in the postmortem. :thumbsup:

Aj T.: FYI — quick patch to runbook proposed: after any key rotation, send 3 dry-run webhooks to each downstream and require 2/3 success before promoting. I'll add to PR.

Support Lead (Carmen): I'll update customers if anything changes.

DevOps Bot: NOTE: automation job 'rotator-v2' flagged for rollback candidate. Tagging eng-infra.

Oncall SRE (Sam): End of real-time thread. Will update incident channel when postmortem is ready.

Maria S.: closing thread.
